title: Senior Data Product Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About Signals:

  • Signals is YipitData’s Company Intelligence platform designed to help private equity firms, venture capital investors, finance, and corporate teams identify, diligence, and monitor software and technology companies using alternative data. Signals provides proprietary spend insights on 250K+ companies into a unified web platform, Chrome extension, and data feeds.
  • Customers use Signals to discover emerging companies, validate market trends, conduct diligence with deeper data (including invoice and product-level detail), and monitor portfolio performance using continuously refreshed alternative data


About The Role:

Our Signals product is quickly growing, and we are scaling our Data Product team to support new customer growth and product coverage expansion through our application, data feeds and AI agent experiences. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Product Analyst to join our Data Product team. This individual will be responsible for managing a team of Data Product Analysts and will own end-to-end delivery for product initiatives, translating product goals into clear plans, leading execution, and ensuring impact across analysis, data operations, and QA workflows.


As a Senior Data Product Analyst, Team Lead, you will:

  • Own strategy and end-to-end execution for a portfolio of high-impact data product initiatives, driving measurable product value through strong product and data judgment
  • Lead a team of 2+ Data Analysts who:
  • Deliver product-facing analyses and datasets, turning messy inputs (ERP financial data, web scraped data, invoices) into clean data insights
  • Build and maintain evaluation datasets and QA guidelines to measure and improve our AI and LLM powered workflows including defining quality targets, running experiments, and iterating based on results
  • Partner with Engineering to translate product needs into scalable workflows for our data products including defining business rules /requirements and improving QA / validation logic
  • Work primarily in Databricks, Google Sheets and with our proprietary AI agent tools, leveraging SQL, PySpark, and Python
  • Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for speed, rigor, and innovation, balancing hands-on efforts yourself for the highest-impact work (complex analyses, ambiguous edge cases, AI evaluation design, and deep dive investigations) with coaching the team so execution scales beyond you
  • Own delivery planning and alignment, translate product goals into clear requirements and execution plans (scope, milestones, risks), apply strong product and data judgment to define what matters, and keep stakeholders aligned through consistent updates
  • Run delivery day to day, drive prioritization and tradeoffs across competing requests, ensure timelines are met, and track/report progress, blockers, and next steps against your plan
  • Partner cross-functionally with Data Science,Engineering, and other key teams to identify leverage points, shape solutions, and drive adoption of improvements that increase product value and operational scalability
  • Have the opportunity to grow your career in the team with increasing levels of responsibility and diversified ownership areas


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Data Engineer or other technical function, including working with large datasets
  • You have 1+ years of experience leading others to deliver strong outcomes, through direct people management and/or team leadership (mentoring, coaching, setting direction, reviewing work, and driving accountability).
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of direct people management experience (including performance management)
  • You have experience working in a high-growth environment and managing many processes in parallel
  • You have experience owning end-to-end delivery for complex initiatives, applying strong product and data judgment to define success metrics, make pragmatic scope tradeoffs, and drive outcomes, including:
  • Scoping ambiguous problems
  • Building execution plans
  • Managing tradeoffs
  • Keeping stakeholders aligned through clear written and verbal updates
  • You are familiar working with large-scale datasets using Python and SQL (nice to have: PySpark, Databricks, and modern AI-assisted tools)
  • You have experience using AI and LLM tools to accelerate data work including generating/refactoring SQL and Python, exploring datasets, drafting labeling guidelines, and validating outputs before applying them to real workflows
  • You are excited to identify and pilot AI driven initiatives, turning repetitive manual work into scalable processes through automation and better tooling while balancing risks and accuracy considerations of new AI systems
  • You have experience with data transformation techniques, maintenance of data pipelines, and quality assurance techniques
  • You are excited about the potential to train and raise the team’s ability to own projects, execute independently, and deliver consistently
  • You are available to work US Eastern time zone hours
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.


Dia a dia

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.
  • Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção.
  • Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time.
  • Traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados, comunicando os resultados de forma clara para audiências técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados.
  • Domínio em Python e principais bibliotecas para Ciência de Dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL (modelagem, performance e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de pipelines de machine learning ponta a ponta em produção (exploração e preparação de dados, limpeza, engenharia de atributos, modelagem e avaliação), com foco em escalabilidade, reprodutibilidade, segurança e monitoramento contínuo de performance dos modelos.
  • Experiência com práticas de engenharia para produção de modelos, incluindo versionamento de código com Git/Github, deploy em nuvem, automação de fluxos e suporte ao monitoramento e manutenção dos modelos em produção.
  • Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.


Diferenciais

  • Formação acadêmica em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com modelagem de risco de crédito, credit scoring ou detecção de fraudes.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de inferência causal e experimentação.
  • Experiência em projetos envolvendo metaheurísticas aplicadas a problemas de otimização combinatória.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência prévia no setor do Agronegócio (AgTechs).
  • Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros ou em projetos relacionados a crédito e risco.
  • Conhecimento em manuseio de dags (Airflow ou similar) para composição de bases de dados para análises exploratórias e treinamento de modelos.


O que temos por aqui:

  • Trabalho remoto, com encontros ocasionais na sede em São José dos Campos - SP.

  • Benefício flexível via cartão Swile.

title: Ingeniero de integración
description:
Job Description: The AI Division in the IT Department needs a Senior Integrations Engineer. The incumbent will mainly focus on the design, implementation and testing of integration solutions supporting the Fund's on-prem and cloud platforms. This position will specifically contribute to the implementation of schedule-based integration components and complementary resources for an important project. In addition, this role will investigate current industry trends from the integrations platform perspective and recommend solutions to any integration challenges using new/latest technologies.


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline; advanced degree in above disciplines preferred.
  • 5-8 years of experience with direct responsibility in software development and/or integrations implementation is required.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in building batch and scheduled processes using Azure Data Factory with its complementary services like DataFlows, Notifications, Integration Runtimes, etc.
  • Experienced in implementing and maintaining data transformations processes/rules as part of the implementation of ADF pipelines.
  • Proficient using APIs, scheduled-based, message-based, and event-based platforms such as Azure Integration Services (API Management/Gateway, Service Bus, Data Factory, Functions, Logic Apps) as well as modern authentication/authorization mechanisms in the context of building/maintaining ADF pipelines and processes.

  • Solid understanding of leveraging cloud-native and hybrid cloud architectures.
  • Strong programming and scripting languages (C#, Java, Python, NodeJS, PowerShell)
  • Knowledge of writing complex and efficient SQL queries for relational and no-SQL databases such as MS SQL Server, CosmosDB, MongoDB, and others. Proficiency building integrations with MS 365 and other CMS is a plus.
  • Familiarity with code versioning and issue tracking tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub.
  • Substantial experience working with DevSecOps tooling; including code auditing and analysis, implementation of CI/CD pipelines, automated release and deployment, infrastructure as code (IaC), and automated security scans.
  • Excellent analytical skills and ability to quickly build credibility and trust with internal colleagues.
  • Great ability to work in a fast-moving environment and with minimal supervision. Also, collaborates across boundaries, gives own perspective and willingly receives diverse perspectives.
  • Excellent documentation (writing and diagramming), interpersonal, and communication skills
  • Ability to pay attention to detail and solve problems and issues efficiently and skilled in developing integration systems in a Scrum/Agile SDLC Environment.

title: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases
description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases


Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


About the Role


We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.


What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration


Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.x
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)


Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Business Strategy Consultant
description:
The Problem We Solve

Organizations collect mountains of data about their customers — and still struggle to act on it. They run surveys, build dashboards, and generate reports, but often lack the structured thinking to turn those outputs into decisions that actually change the business.


This role exists to close that gap.


You will work at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and executive storytelling — helping enterprise clients in financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications understand what their data is telling them and what to do about it.


Who You Are

You are the kind of person who can't look at a dataset without forming a hypothesis. You structure problems before you solve them. You know that a great insight buried in a dense slide is a wasted insight — and you take pride in turning complexity into clarity.


More specifically:

  • You are highly analytical and structured in your thinking — frameworks come naturally to you.
  • You are intellectually curious and comfortable working with ambiguity and open-ended problems.
  • You translate complex analyses into simple, compelling narratives for senior audiences.
  • You are motivated by the full arc: from raw data to strategic recommendation to business impact.
  • You work well independently and collaboratively, and you're not precious about your ideas


What Makes This Role Challenging

You'll often need to build the analytical framework before you can answer the question. Clients don't always know what they need — part of your job is to figure that out alongside them. You'll be expected to move fluidly between quantitative analysis and executive-level communication, sometimes within the same day. This is not a role for someone who wants a clear playbook. It's for someone who wants to write one.


What You Will Work On

  • Diagnosing drivers of customer satisfaction, loyalty, and operational performance across enterprise clients.
  • Structuring insights from large datasets and Voice of Customer programs into strategic recommendations.
  • Developing analytical frameworks that connect behavioral and operational data to business outcomes.
  • Building executive presentations and data-driven narratives for C-level and senior stakeholders.
  • Contributing to consulting proposals and new service offerings — translating insights into commercial value propositions.
  • Supporting the development of consulting methodologies, tools, and analytical approaches.


Key Responsibilities

Analysis & Strategic Thinking

  • Translate complex business problems into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis using Excel and other analytical tools.
  • Develop hypotheses and insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
  • Connect customer behavior, operational metrics, and business performance in coherent analytical narratives


Executive Communication

  • Build executive presentations that communicate findings with clarity and conviction.
  • Synthesize large volumes of information into concise, actionable messages.
  • Adapt communication style to different senior stakeholder audiences.


Commercial & Proposal Development

  • Support the development of consulting proposals and commercial presentations.
  • Help structure value propositions that connect analytical insights to client business challenges.
  • Collaborate in preparing business development materials and new service offerings.


Required Skills

  • Advanced PowerPoint — you build slides that tell a story, not just display data.
  • Advanced Excel — data modeling, analysis, and structuring large datasets.
  • Structured problem-solving and analytical framework development.
  • Ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into strategic recommendations


Nice to Have:

  • SQL, Python, or R.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools.
  • Experience with customer analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or customer journey analysis.
  • Familiarity with CX platforms such as Medallia, Qualtrics, or similar.


Experience & Background

3–6 years in roles such as:

  • Strategy consulting;
  • Business analytics or insights;
  • Strategic planning;
  • Business intelligence or data-driven product roles.


Industry experience in financial services, insurance, retail, telecommunications, or technology is a strong plus.


Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or Marketing.


Languages

  • English — required (you will write and present to global clients in English).
  • Portuguese — required (Brazilian market is core to our client base).
  • Spanish — strong differentiator (several key clients operate across Latin America).


Why Join SMT Advisory

Our clients are large enterprises navigating real strategic challenges — improving how they measure, understand, and act on customer experience across complex operations. The work is analytical, ambiguous, and consequential.


You will have genuine exposure to senior stakeholders at major organizations, contribute to both client delivery and internal capability-building, and work alongside a team that takes the quality of its thinking seriously.


If you're the kind of person who gets more excited by a hard question than an easy answer, this is a good place to be.


Selection Process

As part of the process, candidates will be asked to complete a short analytical case exercise. It is designed to evaluate how you structure a problem, what analytical choices you make, and how clearly you communicate your reasoning — not whether you arrive at a single \"right\" answer.

title: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases
description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases


Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


About the Role


We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.


What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration


Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.x
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)


Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem

Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. O Time de Modelagem é enxuto e focado em resolver problemas complexos de risco de crédito e de análise de dados no agronegócio. Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.


Dia a dia

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.

  • Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time.

Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.

  • Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.


Diferenciais

title: AI Web Engineer (Systems & Automation)
description:
AI Web Engineer (Systems & Automation)

We’re looking for an AI web engineer who can both ship high-quality websites using tools like Claude Code and help us build a repeatable, scalable workflow for how we develop sites.

This role is hands-on. You’ll be building real client websites while also shaping how we do it as a team.


What you’ll do

  • Build production-ready marketing websites and web experiences using AI-assisted workflows (Claude Code, etc.)
  • Work directly from Figma designs and help define a clean Figma → code handoff process
  • Operate in a fast, iterative “vibe coding” style — rapid prototyping, refining, and shipping
  • Identify patterns across projects and turn them into reusable components, structures, and prompts
  • Help establish a repeatable blueprint for how we build websites with AI (structure, tooling, QA, deployment)
  • Collaborate with design and engineering to continuously improve speed and quality


What we’re looking for

  • 4–5 years of experience in web development / frontend engineering
  • Strong experience as a web engineer / frontend developer
  • Proven ability to ship complete websites (not just components or partial work)
  • Experience using AI tools in development workflows (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.)
  • Comfortable working from Figma and translating designs into clean, production-ready code
  • Solid fundamentals in modern web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, frameworks as needed)
  • Ability to move fast, iterate, and make pragmatic decisions
  • Interest in systematizing workflows , not just building one-off projects


Nice to have

  • Experience creating internal tooling, templates, or developer workflows
  • Familiarity with design systems and component libraries
  • Experience working in agency or fast-paced product environments
  • Strong taste in UI implementation and attention to detail


What success looks like

  • You can take a Figma file and turn it into a live, polished website quickly using AI
  • You reduce build time across projects by introducing better workflows and patterns
  • You help turn “vibe coding” into a structured, repeatable system
  • The team can build faster and more consistently because of your contributions


About the role

  • Hands-on engineering role (this is not a pure systems or ops position)
  • High ownership and autonomy
  • Focus on speed, quality, and repeatability

title: Business Strategy Consultant
description:
The Problem We Solve

Organizations collect mountains of data about their customers — and still struggle to act on it. They run surveys, build dashboards, and generate reports, but often lack the structured thinking to turn those outputs into decisions that actually change the business.


This role exists to close that gap.


You will work at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and executive storytelling — helping enterprise clients in financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications understand what their data is telling them and what to do about it.


Who You Are

You are the kind of person who can't look at a dataset without forming a hypothesis. You structure problems before you solve them. You know that a great insight buried in a dense slide is a wasted insight — and you take pride in turning complexity into clarity.


More specifically:

  • You are highly analytical and structured in your thinking — frameworks come naturally to you.
  • You are intellectually curious and comfortable working with ambiguity and open-ended problems.
  • You translate complex analyses into simple, compelling narratives for senior audiences.
  • You are motivated by the full arc: from raw data to strategic recommendation to business impact.
  • You work well independently and collaboratively, and you're not precious about your ideas


What Makes This Role Challenging

You'll often need to build the analytical framework before you can answer the question. Clients don't always know what they need — part of your job is to figure that out alongside them. You'll be expected to move fluidly between quantitative analysis and executive-level communication, sometimes within the same day. This is not a role for someone who wants a clear playbook. It's for someone who wants to write one.


What You Will Work On

  • Diagnosing drivers of customer satisfaction, loyalty, and operational performance across enterprise clients.
  • Structuring insights from large datasets and Voice of Customer programs into strategic recommendations.
  • Developing analytical frameworks that connect behavioral and operational data to business outcomes.
  • Building executive presentations and data-driven narratives for C-level and senior stakeholders.
  • Contributing to consulting proposals and new service offerings — translating insights into commercial value propositions.
  • Supporting the development of consulting methodologies, tools, and analytical approaches.


Key Responsibilities

Analysis & Strategic Thinking

  • Translate complex business problems into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis using Excel and other analytical tools.
  • Develop hypotheses and insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
  • Connect customer behavior, operational metrics, and business performance in coherent analytical narratives


Executive Communication

  • Build executive presentations that communicate findings with clarity and conviction.
  • Synthesize large volumes of information into concise, actionable messages.
  • Adapt communication style to different senior stakeholder audiences.


Commercial & Proposal Development

  • Support the development of consulting proposals and commercial presentations.
  • Help structure value propositions that connect analytical insights to client business challenges.
  • Collaborate in preparing business development materials and new service offerings.


Required Skills

  • Advanced PowerPoint — you build slides that tell a story, not just display data.
  • Advanced Excel — data modeling, analysis, and structuring large datasets.
  • Structured problem-solving and analytical framework development.
  • Ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into strategic recommendations


Nice to Have:

  • SQL, Python, or R.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools.
  • Experience with customer analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or customer journey analysis.
  • Familiarity with CX platforms such as Medallia, Qualtrics, or similar.


Experience & Background

3–6 years in roles such as:

  • Strategy consulting;
  • Business analytics or insights;
  • Strategic planning;
  • Business intelligence or data-driven product roles.


Industry experience in financial services, insurance, retail, telecommunications, or technology is a strong plus.


Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or Marketing.


Languages

  • English — required (you will write and present to global clients in English).
  • Portuguese — required (Brazilian market is core to our client base).
  • Spanish — strong differentiator (several key clients operate across Latin America).


Why Join SMT Advisory

Our clients are large enterprises navigating real strategic challenges — improving how they measure, understand, and act on customer experience across complex operations. The work is analytical, ambiguous, and consequential.


You will have genuine exposure to senior stakeholders at major organizations, contribute to both client delivery and internal capability-building, and work alongside a team that takes the quality of its thinking seriously.


If you're the kind of person who gets more excited by a hard question than an easy answer, this is a good place to be.


Selection Process

As part of the process, candidates will be asked to complete a short analytical case exercise. It is designed to evaluate how you structure a problem, what analytical choices you make, and how clearly you communicate your reasoning — not whether you arrive at a single \"right\" answer.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando ser seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem

Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. O Time de Modelagem é enxuto e focado em resolver problemas complexos de risco de crédito e de análise de dados no agronegócio. Buscamos um Cientista de Dados experiente, com perfil voltado para mentoria e trabalho em equipe.

Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.


Dia a dia

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.
  • Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção.
  • Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time.
  • Traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados, comunicando os resultados de forma clara para audiências técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados.

title: Tech Lead Java
description:
Tech Lead Java

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você atuará como principal referência técnica de TI para o time e para o cliente, sendo responsável por garantir a qualidade das entregas, a evolução técnica da equipe e um ambiente colaborativo alinhado à cultura. Além disso, terá um papel ativo na gestão das entregas, acompanhando o andamento das atividades, identificando riscos e garantindo que os compromissos assumidos sejam cumpridos com qualidade. Também contribuirá com decisões de arquitetura e direcionamento técnico, apoiando o time na construção de soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas às boas práticas. Por fim, será responsável por desenvolver o time, atuando com mentoria, feedbacks técnicos e nivelamento de conhecimento.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Alinhar objetivos do time e assegurar a execução dos processos internos;
  • Acompanhar dinâmicas de equipes ágeis, facilitando a comunicação e desbloqueando obstáculos;
  • Apoiar o time de projetos na criação de cronogramas e estimativas;
  • Realizar entrevistas técnica para novos membros e definir perfis necessários junto à coordenação;
  • Assegurar que as ferramentas de trabalho (JIRA, documentação) estejam atualizadas;
  • Resolver conflitos e manter um ambiente colaborativo, positivo e focado em resultados.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java , com atuação consistente em ambientes de produção e entendimento do ciclo completo de desenvolvimento (do desenho à sustentação);
  • Domínio de Spring Boot , incluindo construção de APIs, segurança, persistência de dados e organização de aplicações escaláveis e de fácil manutenção;
  • Conhecimento prático em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL, com capacidade de modelagem, escrita de queries eficientes e entendimento de performance e uso adequado de cada tecnologia;
  • Vivência com AWS , compreendendo o uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda no contexto de aplicações reais, incluindo deploy, configuração e monitoramento básico;
  • Experiência com containers (Docker e/ou Kubernetes ), entendendo o ciclo de vida das aplicações e sua execução em ambientes containerizados;
  • Experiência na construção e integração de APIs RESTful , seguindo boas práticas de design, versionamento e segurança;
  • Familiaridade com controle de versão utilizando Git, incluindo colaboração em equipe, code review e organização de branches;
  • Experiência com testes unitários, garantindo qualidade e confiabilidade do código entregue;
  • Vivência atuando como referência técnica ou liderança de times, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e contribuindo com a evolução técnica da equipe;
  • Capacidade analítica, autonomia, proatividade e segurança na tomada de decisão em cenários de pressão ou ambiguidade.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir experiência com práticas de DevOps e construção de pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Tiver vivência com desenvolvimento de arquiteturas resilientes e escaláveis;
  • Tiver conhecimento em ferramentas de busca e monitoramento, como ElasticSearch.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

description:
We are hiring – Rubber Compound Engineers


We are looking for experienced Rubber Engineers (Compound Specialists) to join our team in:

China

Hong Kong

Brazil


Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18, 1988, specializes in the import, export, and distribution of high-quality tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. SUNSET TIRES is committed to excellence, offering tailored services to meet the needs of its clients in various sectors. The company prides itself on its tradition and expertise in the tire and automotive industry.

This is a contract, role for a Rubber Compound Engineer. The responsibilities include developing and optimizing rubber compounds tailored to specific applications, evaluating the performance of compounds, and conducting quality assurance testing. The engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess raw materials, address production challenges, and ensure compliance with performance standards. The role also demands preparing technical documentation and staying updated on advancements in materials and rubber manufacturing processes. Place of work: China, Hong Kong or Brazil.

  • Strong knowledge of rubber compounding, material science, and chemical composition

  • Analytical skills for troubleshooting production issues and optimizing formulations
  • Proficiency in technical documentation and reporting
  • Team collaboration and communication abilities for cross-functional project work
  • Familiarity with industry regulations, sustainability practices, and innovation in rubber materials is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related field

  • Salary: BRL 8,000/month
  • Contract Period: April 20, 2026 – November 30, 2026


About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Business Process Analyst I to support the design, optimization, and visibility of Go-To-Market (GTM) processes.   • Build simple dashboards or reporting views to highlight execution risks and performance gaps

3. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Facilitate working sessions with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations
  • Capture key decisions and translate them into structured documentation
  • Support ongoing initiatives with data-driven analysis and consistent follow-through


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field
  • 1–3 years of experience in business analysis, operations, or process improvement
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with process mapping and documentation
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and reporting/dashboard tools is a plus
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with GTM processes or Revenue Operations
  • Knowledge of pipeline management and sales metrics
  • Basic understanding of data analysis tools (Excel, BI tools, etc.)

description:

A Access International Services é uma consultoria internacional em expansão, especializada em mobilidade global, estruturação patrimonial e soluções jurídicas estratégicas para clientes que buscam viver, investir ou expandir suas operações fora do Brasil.

title: Sr Third-Party Cybersecurity Risk Analyst
description:
Sr Third-Party Cybersecurity Risk Analyst


Start Date: ASAP

Duration: 6 Months w/possible extension

City: Remote

Candidates must be located in Brazil, (Sao Paolo preferred)

Client Industry: Agriculture



Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Systems, Risk Management, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 7+ years of experience in third-party risk management, cybersecurity risk, or GRC.
  • Proven experience building or significantly enhancing a TPRM program.
  • Strong experience reviewing SOC 2 reports and vendor security questionnaires.
  • Experience conducting vendor cybersecurity assessments.
  • Hands-on experience with a GRC platform (e.g., RSA Archer, LogicManager, ServiceNow GRC, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of vendor risk frameworks and control environments.
  • Experience writing clear, executive-level risk reports.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in fast-paced, build-mode environments.
  • Excellent analytical, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and drive initiatives to completion.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and mature the enterprise data governance framework, policies, standards, and operating model.
  • Establish and maintain data ownership, stewardship, and accountability structures.
  • Stand up and manage governance forums, working groups, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Build and maintain the enterprise data inventory and data domain model.
  • Define requirements for data collection, ownership assignment, and classification at creation.
  • Embed governance and classification controls into system development and intake processes.
  • Maintain the enterprise data classification framework and associated handling and protection requirements.
  • Map regulatory and contractual obligations to data classes and ensure appropriate controls are enforced.
  • Define secure data storage requirements and validate compliance with encryption, access, and monitoring standards.
  • Monitor storage environments to prevent unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
  • Govern role‑based access, periodic reviews, and monitoring of data usage and behavior.
  • Partner with cross functional teams to detect and respond to inappropriate access.
  • Establish secure data sharing and transmission standards and govern internal/external disclosures.
  • Maintain approval workflows, logging, and traceability for data transfers.
  • Assess data sharing risks in partnership with Third‑Party Risk Management.
  • Develop and maintain data retention schedules aligned with legal, regulatory, and business needs.
  • Govern archival processes and access restrictions for inactive data.
  • Define secure data destruction standards, validate retention obligations, and maintain destruction evidence.
  • Oversee third‑party destruction activities for compliance.
  • Develop KPIs, KRIs, maturity metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  • Identify program gaps, drive remediation, and support audits and regulatory examinations.
  • Serve as the enterprise SME for data governance, providing training and awareness.
  • Build relationships with IT, Security, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and business units to promote adoption.
  • Support AI governance and trusted‑data initiatives.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando ser seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


Como é trabalhar na TM?

Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Aqui, precisamos de pessoas comprometidas e prontas para novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão: levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.


Dia a dia

  • Contribuir ativamente para a criação e evolução de produtos e serviços no universo de Crédito e Risco.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de negócios para entender requisitos de dados e entregar soluções técnicas avançadas.
  • Desenvolver pipelines robustos de ingestão de dados massivos (batch, near real-time e real-time), garantindo confiabilidade e eficiência.
  • Assegurar que a arquitetura de dados esteja alinhada com os objetivos do negócio.
  • Trabalhar com equipes multifuncionais para integrar dados em nossos produtos e serviços.
  • Identificar oportunidades para aquisição de novos dados e propor melhorias contínuas em disponibilidade, confiabilidade e eficiência.
  • Facilitar a democratização dos dados em toda a empresa.
  • Compreender profundamente os produtos e serviços da TerraMagna para melhor atender às necessidades internas.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.


Requisitos

  • 5+ anos de experiência em engenharia de dados e/ou desenvolvimento de software, com ênfase em grandes volumes de dados e alta disponibilidade.
  • Forte domínio de Python (nível produção) e SQL avançado (modelagem, performance, manipulação de grandes volumes).
  • Experiência prática na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados batch e near real-time.
  • Experiência com mensageria e processamento de eventos (Pub/Sub, Kafka ou similares).
  • Experiência com orquestração de workflows (Airflow ou similar).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de transformação de dados (dbt ou similar).
  • Experiência em ambientes de nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .
  • Versionamento de código com Git/GitHub .
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou similar).
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de modelagem de dados (dimensional, relacional, data vault), particionamento e otimização de queries.
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação e colaboração com times técnicos e de negócio.
  • Perfil proativo, orientado a resultados e com forte capacidade de resolução de problemas.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com BigQuery , Kubernetes (GKE) , Cloud Storage , Pub/Sub e Docker .
  • Familiaridade com dbt , Dataform ou ferramentas similares de transformação de dados.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados em múltiplas camadas (raw, trusted, refined, datamart).
  • Experiência com integração de APIs externas ou ingestão de dados não estruturados.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos e ferramentas de Lakehouse (Delta Lake, Databricks, Cloudera).
  • Experiência com Spark , Flink ou frameworks de processamento distribuído.
  • Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros ou em projetos relacionados a crédito e risco.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI e Data Apps (Streamlit, Tableau, Qlik).


O que temos por aqui:

  • Trabalho remoto (encontros ocasionais na sede em São José dos Campos/SP)
  • Remuneração compatível (PJ)
  • Benefício flexível via cartão Swile
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass)
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto

title: Ingeniero de integración
description:
Job Description: The AI Division in the IT Department needs a Senior Integrations Engineer. The incumbent will mainly focus on the design, implementation and testing of integration solutions supporting the Fund's on-prem and cloud platforms. This position will specifically contribute to the implementation of schedule-based integration components and complementary resources for an important project. In addition, this role will investigate current industry trends from the integrations platform perspective and recommend solutions to any integration challenges using new/latest technologies.


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline; advanced degree in above disciplines preferred.
  • 5-8 years of experience with direct responsibility in software development and/or integrations implementation is required.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in building batch and scheduled processes using Azure Data Factory with its complementary services like DataFlows, Notifications, Integration Runtimes, etc.
  • Experienced in implementing and maintaining data transformations processes/rules as part of the implementation of ADF pipelines.
  • Proficient using APIs, scheduled-based, message-based, and event-based platforms such as Azure Integration Services (API Management/Gateway, Service Bus, Data Factory, Functions, Logic Apps) as well as modern authentication/authorization mechanisms in the context of building/maintaining ADF pipelines and processes.
  • Working knowledge of parsing/transforming data coming from SOA (Service Oriented Architecture) and REST (Representational State Transfer) services in the context of implementing ADF pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of leveraging cloud-native and hybrid cloud architectures.
  • Strong programming and scripting languages (C#, Java, Python, NodeJS, PowerShell)
  • Knowledge of writing complex and efficient SQL queries for relational and no-SQL databases such as MS SQL Server, CosmosDB, MongoDB, and others. Proficiency building integrations with MS 365 and other CMS is a plus.
  • Familiarity with code versioning and issue tracking tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub.
  • Substantial experience working with DevSecOps tooling; including code auditing and analysis, implementation of CI/CD pipelines, automated release and deployment, infrastructure as code (IaC), and automated security scans.
  • Excellent analytical skills and ability to quickly build credibility and trust with internal colleagues.
  • Great ability to work in a fast-moving environment and with minimal supervision. Also, collaborates across boundaries, gives own perspective and willingly receives diverse perspectives.
  • Excellent documentation (writing and diagramming), interpersonal, and communication skills
  • Ability to pay attention to detail and solve problems and issues efficiently and skilled in developing integration systems in a Scrum/Agile SDLC Environment.

title: Senior Consultant
description:
Job Overview:

This role focuses on advising clients on regulatory frameworks and compliance within the Brazilian crypto sector. It involves supporting licensing and authorization processes, engaging with regulators, and keeping clients updated on regulatory developments. The position also includes delivering strategic insights, training stakeholders, and contributing to business growth through industry engagement.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform detailed evaluations and analyses of relevant regulatory frameworks, market developments, competitive landscapes, and macroeconomic policies across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Deliver tailored training sessions to the client’s board members, senior leadership, and compliance teams.
  • Support the assessment and fulfilment of existing and upcoming regulatory requirements in selected jurisdictions.
  • Keep clients up to date on regulatory changes and compliance obligations.
  • Provide technical guidance on applications for authorization, licensing, and registration.
  • Oversee the preparation and submission of documentation to regulators, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Track application progress and provide ad hoc assistance throughout the authorization, licensing, and registration processes.
  • Identify and develop business opportunities and represent the company at industry conferences and events to strengthen visibility and drive growth.
  • Conduct thorough research on regulatory trends and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making


Qualifications:

  • Good experience as a Public Servant, Lobbyist, or in a similar regulatory-focused role.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory environment, particularly within the crypto sector.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities.
  • Strategic mindset with the capacity to deliver meaningful insights to both clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to work autonomously while also collaborating effectively in a fast-paced team setting.
  • Well-established professional network within key institutions, including but not limited to the Central Bank and the National Congress.

title: Designer de Produto
description:
• Sobre a Payfy

A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia, e você precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito.


  • O desafio

Você vai atuar junto de um time de ~20 de Produto (PM, devs, dados) para evoluir a experiência e o produto de ponta a ponta.

Essa não é uma posição para quem usa IA eventualmente. É para quem já incorporou IA no workflow e tem senso crítico para saber quando usar e quando não usar.


  • O que você vai fazer
  • Conduzir pesquisa com usuários (entrevistas, testes, descoberta contínua) e transformar insights em direção clara — usando IA para acelerar síntese e análise de feedback
  • Usar IA ativamente no workflow: geração de variações, rascunhos de stories, análise de dados qualitativos, automação de etapas repetitivas e muito mais
  • Conduzir iterações rápidas de protótipos (do rascunho ao validado) antes de buildar, com apoio de ferramentas de IA para ganhar velocidade sem perder qualidade
  • Manter sistema e consistência na experiência: design system, padrões, acessibilidade e handoff
  • Trabalhar com métricas e experimentação (funil, eventos, testes A/B) para orientar decisões com evidência



  • O que buscamos
  • Uso real de IA no dia a dia de design: Cria workflows, usa ferramentas como Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Galileo AI ou similares. Não é IA por moda — é IA com propósito.
  • Maturidade de discovery: Sabe definir problema, hipótese, método certo e chegar em decisão com evidência.
  • Qualidade de escrita: User stories claras, critérios de aceite objetivos e comunicação direta com o time.
  • Senso de produto e negócio (fintech): Entende trade-offs de conversão, retenção, risco e compliance.
  • Sistema e consistência: Experiência com design system, padrões e cuidado com edge cases.
  • Métricas e experimentação: Conforto em acompanhar impacto, instrumentação básica e aprendizado contínuo.



  • O que não buscamos
  • Quem usa IA apenas para gerar imagens bonitas, sem integrar ao processo de design e descoberta
  • Perfis focados só em execução visual, sem interesse em produto, dados e estratégia
  • Falta de experiência com sistemas em produção e ambientes com ritmo acelerado



  • O que oferecemos
  • 100% remoto | Contratação PJ
  • Remuneração: de R$20k – R$25k a combinar.
  • Autonomia real para evoluir o design do produto
  • Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível
  • Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e disseminar



Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer.

Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

title: Analista Contábil Pleno
description:
A Culture Designer, consultoria em gestão de pessoas, está apoiando uma consultoria contábil estratégica na contratação de um profissional para atuar na área contábil com foco consultivo e relacionamento com clientes!


Conheça um pouco sobre a empresa contratante

Com mais de 20 anos de atuação sólida no mercado brasileiro, a empresa é especializada em impulsionar o crescimento de empresas de base tecnológica, startups e agências de inovação. Seu diferencial está em transformar a contabilidade tradicional em uma ferramenta estratégica de inteligência de negócios. Com uma cultura dinâmica e orientada ao suporte consultivo, a organização atua de forma próxima aos clientes, utilizando tecnologia de ponta e um atendimento altamente personalizado para apoiar gestores na tomada de decisões mais assertivas.


Principais Atividades:

  • Atuação na gestão de carteira de clientes, acompanhando e conduzindo processos contábeis de empresas de diferentes portes.
  • Responsável pela execução da rotina contábil completa, incluindo lançamentos, conciliações bancárias, apuração de impostos e fechamento contábil mensal.
  • Elaboração de demonstrativos e relatórios contábeis gerenciais, como balancetes, com apresentação de informações para a controladoria.
  • Atuação consultiva junto aos clientes, oferecendo assessoria contábil, fiscal e tributária, com recomendações personalizadas para melhoria de processos e tomada de decisão.
  • Participação ativa em reuniões com clientes, esclarecendo dúvidas, apresentando análises e propondo melhorias.
  • Garantia de compliance contábil, assegurando o cumprimento das normas e legislações vigentes.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com rotina contábil completa.
  • Vivência com elaboração de balancetes e relatórios contábeis.
  • Conhecimento na ferramenta Domínio.
  • Domínio de Excel.
  • Diferencial: conhecimento na ferramenta Conta Azul.


Soft Skills:

  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Organização e boa gestão do tempo.
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas.
  • Raciocínio lógico e pensamento crítico.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para elaboração de pareceres técnicos.
  • Facilidade de relacionamento com clientes.


Remuneração & Benefícios:


Remuneração: Estamos trabalhando com a expectativa salarial, favor informar sua pretensão no seu formulário de cadastro conosco.

  • Plano de saúde sem mensalidade (com coparticipação).
  • Plano odontológico.
  • Seguro de vida.

  • Auxílio creche.
  • Parceria com Sesc.
  • Day off.
  • Gympass.
  • Conexa Saúde.

description:
AI Web Engineer (Systems & Automation)

We’re looking for an AI web engineer who can both ship high-quality websites using tools like Claude Code and help us build a repeatable, scalable workflow for how we develop sites.

This role is hands-on. You’ll be building real client websites while also shaping how we do it as a team.


What you’ll do

  • Build production-ready marketing websites and web experiences using AI-assisted workflows (Claude Code, etc.)
  • Work directly from Figma designs and help define a clean Figma → code handoff process
  • Operate in a fast, iterative “vibe coding” style — rapid prototyping, refining, and shipping
  • Identify patterns across projects and turn them into reusable components, structures, and prompts
  • Help establish a repeatable blueprint for how we build websites with AI (structure, tooling, QA, deployment)
  • Collaborate with design and engineering to continuously improve speed and quality


What we’re looking for

  • 4–5 years of experience in web development / frontend engineering
  • Strong experience as a web engineer / frontend developer
  • Proven ability to ship complete websites (not just components or partial work)
  • Experience using AI tools in development workflows (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.)
  • Comfortable working from Figma and translating designs into clean, production-ready code
  • Solid fundamentals in modern web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, frameworks as needed)
  • Ability to move fast, iterate, and make pragmatic decisions
  • Interest in systematizing workflows , not just building one-off projects


Nice to have

  • Experience creating internal tooling, templates, or developer workflows
  • Familiarity with design systems and component libraries
  • Experience working in agency or fast-paced product environments
  • Strong taste in UI implementation and attention to detail


What success looks like

  • You can take a Figma file and turn it into a live, polished website quickly using AI
  • You reduce build time across projects by introducing better workflows and patterns
  • You help turn “vibe coding” into a structured, repeatable system
  • The team can build faster and more consistently because of your contributions


About the role

  • Hands-on engineering role (this is not a pure systems or ops position)
  • High ownership and autonomy
  • Focus on speed, quality, and repeatability

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We are looking for a Product-Led Marketing & Digital Funnels Manager to own and scale customer acquisition through paid media, webinars, and product-driven marketing funnels for our K-12 solutions.


This role is responsible for building and optimizing full-funnel digital programs from ads to webinars to product demos that generate qualified pipeline and revenue. You will operate at the intersection of product marketing, demand generation, and digital growth, turning interest into engaged prospects and customers through high-performing funnel systems.


Responsibilities

  • Own paid ads strategy across LinkedIn, Google, and retargeting to drive qualified leads
  • Manage and scale webinar programs from promotion through follow-up and conversion
  • Build and optimize digital funnels from ad to landing page to demo or sales opportunity
  • Create and improve landing pages, email nurture sequences, and conversion paths
  • Track and optimize funnel performance including conversion rates, CPL, and pipeline generated
  • Run A/B tests and scale campaigns that consistently generate pipeline


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, demand generation, or funnel management, preferably in K-12, EdTech, or SaaS
  • Proven experience running paid ads, webinars, and digital funnel programs that generate pipeline
  • Strong understanding of product-led marketing and multi-touch buyer journeys
  • Experience with marketing and CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn Ads, and Google Ads
  • Analytical and results-driven with a focus on conversion and revenue metrics
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Data Specialist - Project
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Data Specialist with 5+ years of experience in data analysis, validation, and transformation. This role focuses on reviewing and validating data from multiple sources, ensuring accurate mapping into standardized formats, and maintaining high data quality across pipelines. The ideal candidate has experience working with raw data files, SQL-based systems, and AWS data environments.

This project has a 3-6 month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.


Responsibilities

  • Data Validation & Quality Assurance
  • Analyze raw data from clients, devices, and external sources
  • Validate that data is correctly processed, transformed, and stored
  • Identify inconsistencies, anomalies, and data quality issues
  • Ensure outputs match expected results after processing
  • Review and validate data mappings created by engineering teams
  • Ensure raw data is accurately converted into standard formats
  • Collaborate with data engineers to refine and improve mapping logic
  • Take ownership of data quality across systems and workflows
  • Establish and enforce best practices for data validation and integrity
  • Act as a guide for teams to ensure reliable data processing
  • Work closely with data engineering, application engineering, and product teams to ensure alignment on data needs
  • Provide feedback on data issues and recommend improvements
  • Bridge the gap between raw data ingestion and business-ready datasets


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of data validation experience
  • Strong analytical mindset with a focus on data quality and validation
  • Experience working with structured and semi-structured data
  • Ability to interpret and validate data transformations and mappings
  • Solid understanding of SQL and data querying
  • Experience working in data pipelines or data engineering environments
  • Hands-on experience with data formats such as CSV, JSON, XML, and flat files
  • Familiarity with SQL-compliant databases
  • Exposure to AWS-based data environments
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Apache Iceberg and working with event-based or sensor data (e.g., fuel systems, industrial, or IoT data) is a plus.
  • Experience with data platforms such as Apache Iceberg (or similar)


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions. Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Designer de Produto
description:
• Sobre a Payfy

A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia, e você precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito.


  • O desafio

Você vai atuar junto de um time de ~20 de Produto (PM, devs, dados) para evoluir a experiência e o produto de ponta a ponta.

Essa não é uma posição para quem usa IA eventualmente. É para quem já incorporou IA no workflow e tem senso crítico para saber quando usar e quando não usar.


  • O que você vai fazer
  • Conduzir pesquisa com usuários (entrevistas, testes, descoberta contínua) e transformar insights em direção clara — usando IA para acelerar síntese e análise de feedback
  • Usar IA ativamente no workflow: geração de variações, rascunhos de stories, análise de dados qualitativos, automação de etapas repetitivas e muito mais
  • Conduzir iterações rápidas de protótipos (do rascunho ao validado) antes de buildar, com apoio de ferramentas de IA para ganhar velocidade sem perder qualidade
  • Manter sistema e consistência na experiência: design system, padrões, acessibilidade e handoff
  • Trabalhar com métricas e experimentação (funil, eventos, testes A/B) para orientar decisões com evidência



  • O que buscamos
  • Uso real de IA no dia a dia de design: Cria workflows, usa ferramentas como Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Galileo AI ou similares. Não é IA por moda — é IA com propósito.
  • Maturidade de discovery: Sabe definir problema, hipótese, método certo e chegar em decisão com evidência.
  • Qualidade de escrita: User stories claras, critérios de aceite objetivos e comunicação direta com o time.
  • Senso de produto e negócio (fintech): Entende trade-offs de conversão, retenção, risco e compliance.
  • Sistema e consistência: Experiência com design system, padrões e cuidado com edge cases.
  • Métricas e experimentação: Conforto em acompanhar impacto, instrumentação básica e aprendizado contínuo.



  • O que não buscamos
  • Quem usa IA apenas para gerar imagens bonitas, sem integrar ao processo de design e descoberta
  • Perfis focados só em execução visual, sem interesse em produto, dados e estratégia
  • Falta de experiência com sistemas em produção e ambientes com ritmo acelerado



  • O que oferecemos
  • 100% remoto | Contratação PJ
  • Remuneração: de R$20k – R$25k a combinar.
  • Autonomia real para evoluir o design do produto
  • Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível
  • Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e disseminar



Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer.

Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

title: Business Operations Analyst (Process & GTM)
description:
We’re hiring: Business Operations Analyst (Process & GTM)


We are looking for a Business Operations Analyst to support process design, execution, and performance visibility across global go-to-market teams.

This role sits at the intersection of process, data, and business operations, supporting Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success in a fast-paced, tech-driven environment.


What you’ll be doing

  • Map and optimize end-to-end processes across the commercial lifecycle (lead to deal to renewal)
  • Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and friction points in current workflows
  • Define and standardize key metrics (conversion, pipeline health, deal velocity, renewals)
  • Build simple dashboards and reports to improve execution visibility
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Translate discussions into clear process documentation and actionable playbooks


What we’re looking for

  • Experience with process analysis and documentation
  • Familiarity with tools like Lucidchart, Visio, or similar
  • Strong analytical skills and experience working with KPIs and metrics
  • Advanced Excel skills


Nice to have

  • Experience with Power BI or similar tools
  • Knowledge of Salesforce or CRM systems
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments


Profile

  • Structured and detail-oriented
  • Strong problem-solving mindset
  • Comfortable working across teams
  • Proactive and organized
